# W6 handoff: Upstreams and Pulls

Workstream W6 of [`15-build-plan.md`](../../spec/15-build-plan.md), on branch `ws/w6-upstreams` from the phase 0 commit `b3ed701`. Owns `internal/upstream` (with `deps`, `importer` and `upstreamtest`), `internal/api/{discover,pulls,mirrors,admin_upstreams}.go` and `compat/upstream`. Changes needed elsewhere, and two decisions to confirm, are in [`requests/w6.md`](../requests/w6.md).

## Done, by feature ID

| ID | What | Where |
|---|---|---|
| PULL-1 | Upstreams in the `upstreams` table: configured ones kept in step at start-up (`SyncConfig`; an admin's disable survives a restart, `enabled: false` always wins, removed ones are disabled, not deleted), admin ones with create, update, delete (refused while Mirrors use them) and a connection test. Instance tokens are AES-256-GCM under the Instance key and never returned. Audit event `upstream.changed`. `/upstreams` lists enabled ones for users; `/admin/upstreams*` for Instance admins. | `upstream.Registry`, `api.Upstreams` |
| PULL-2 | Pulls of a whole Repo, globs (`include`, `exclude`, fnmatch as `allow_patterns`), paths, quants or dataset Configs and Splits, as a Mirror that keeps the upstream ID and Commit SHAs. The first Pull into an unknown Namespace creates a reserved Mirror Namespace (W5's `EnsureMirrorNamespace`); a local Namespace or another Upstream's Mirror with the ID is a clear conflict, and `namespace_prefix` maps IDs (`hf-jinaai/...`). Pulls of the same files join the existing Job. | `Service.StartPull`, `plan.go` |
| PULL-2 (history) | git smart HTTP fetch, protocol v2 (`ls-refs` with `peel`, `fetch` with every advertised object as a want and the Mirror's tips as haves, no thin packs) with a protocol v0 fallback, using go-git v6's pkt-line and side-band packages. The pack streams into `repo.Service.ApplyPack` (`SourceMirror`) with compare-and-swap of every ref; `refs/heads`, `tags`, `pr` and `convert` are mirrored. A Pull of a Revision already held skips the fetch. | `gitfetch.go`, `Service.fetchHistory` |
| PULL-3 | Partial mirrors: `repo_lfs` presence from W2's `ApplyPack`; selected objects already stored are marked present with no transfer; the rest stay "not in arsenal". `POST .../mirror/pull` pulls more; the Mirror's selection is the union of its Pulls. | `plan.go`, `api.Upstreams.PullMoreIntoMirror` |
| PULL-4 | GGUF quant selection by name (split files as one group, `mmproj-*` projectors with any quant), stored as quant names so tracking follows renamed files. Discover shows quant groups with sizes and presence. | `Matcher`, `DiscoverDetail` |
| PULL-5 | One pull Job is the whole Pull: it plans, then re-checks its `pull.file` Jobs and Dependency Pulls every `PollInterval` with `jobs.Snooze` (no attempt used), reporting bytes done and total, rate, ETA and per-file status; its result holds the phase and per-file errors. Cancelling it cancels its transfers (W1). A failed file ends the Pull `partial` (Job failed, result `phase: partial`); retrying the Job transfers only what is missing. Transfers resume after restarts and lease expiry. | `runPull`, `GET /pulls/{id}` |
| PULL-6 | Objects stream into `repo.LFSStore` (`Ingest` up to the part size, multipart above it, 64 MiB parts), which verifies SHA-256 and size before anything is visible; a mismatch is rejected and downloaded again. The Hub's `X-Linked-Etag` and `X-Linked-Size` are checked before the transfer. | `transfer.go` |
| PULL-7 | Every byte goes through `jobs.Limiter.WaitN("pull", n)` in 64 KiB steps, with `hangar.pull.bytes`, `hangar.pull.rate_limited.duration` and `hangar.pull.files{outcome}`. Pull windows: a `pull.file` Job outside a window snoozes until it opens with the progress message "Waiting for pull window (01:00-07:00)"; a running multipart transfer stops at the next part boundary. "Pull now" (`now: true`) ignores windows, not the cap, when `pull.allow_override_windows` is on. `pull.concurrency` is W1's per-kind Instance limit. | `waitForWindow`, `meteredReader` |
| PULL-8 | Credentials: the requesting user's upstream token (W5's store), else the Instance token, else none. Tokens go in `Authorization` only and are dropped on every redirect to another origin (also same host, other port). Private and gated upstream Repos make private Mirrors. | `Service.credentials`, `HTTPClient` |
| PULL-9 | Tracking: `track: true` sets a `mirror.sync` schedule (every 6 hours at a minute derived from the Repo, or the Mirror's cron), which queues a sync Pull of the tracked branch with the Mirror's selection; force-pushes are applied and replaced branch tips are kept as `refs/hangar/previous/<timestamp>/heads/<branch>`. `PATCH .../mirror` changes selection, tracking, branch and schedule; `POST .../mirror/sync` syncs now; `POST .../mirror/detach` makes an ordinary Repo (W2's `SetMirrorState`). `GET .../mirror` shows state and `update_available`. | `sync.go`, `api/mirrors.go` |
| PULL-10 | Pull-through, off by default, with `pull.pull_through.allow` globs and `min_role`: `Repo` starts or joins a history-only Pull and waits for planning (30 seconds, then `ErrPullPending`); `File` streams a not-present object while it arrives, concurrent requests in a process share one transfer through a spool file, and a transfer running on another replica is waited for; `DownloadURL` gives git-lfs a signed Hangar URL served by `Handler`. | `pullthrough.go`, `hub.go` |
| PULL-11 | Dependencies from `auto_map` (string and list values, `@revision`, same-Repo values ignored) in five config files, `adapter_config.json`, Model card `base_model` and `datasets`, `modules.json` and `model_index.json`; stored per Commit; code Dependencies pulled automatically and recursively (cycle detection, `max_depth`), base models with `auto_pull_base_models`; a Pull completes only when its code Dependencies do. `GET .../dependencies` shows "needs" and "needed by" with Arsenal state; `ResolveDependencies` serves uploaded Repos. | `deps/`, `startDependencies`, `Graph` |
| PULL-12 | Bulk import library for W9's `hangar import`: `--from-hf-cache` (Mirror planned against the Upstream at the cached Commit, then only cached files whose SHA-256 matches the planned LFS objects are uploaded, then marked present with no transfer; `--offline` makes local Repos with one Commit), `--from-dir`, `--from-lmstudio` (matched to the Upstream Repo of the same name by SHA-256, else a local Repo) and `--from-ollama` (GGUF per tag plus template, system, params and licence). `HTTPTarget` talks to an Instance's native API and Hub API with a Token. | `importer/` |
| BROWSE-2 backend | Discover search with Hub facets passed through, sort `trending`, `downloads`, `likes`, `lastModified`, cursor pages; each result marked `none`, `partial` or `full` as the caller sees the Arsenal (private Mirrors are `none` to others) with `local_sha` when the Upstream moved on. Results cached for 5 minutes per Upstream, query and token hash. Detail: files with sizes and presence, quant picker, card, total size, the Dependencies Hangar would pull with their state. | `discover.go`, `api/discover.go` |
| DATA-7 | Discover for datasets (`/discover/datasets`), with Configs, Splits, row counts and sizes and a first-rows preview from the Upstream's Dataset Viewer (`datasets-server.<host>`, or `viewer_url`). | `upstreamDatasetInfo` |
| DATA-8 | Config and Split selections resolved through `datasets.Layout` to file patterns at the Revision; Parquet-only selections pull those Splits from `refs/convert/parquet`; stored by name so tracking follows new files. | `DatasetPatterns`, `plan.go` |

Also: the Hub client honours `Retry-After` and backs off with full jitter on 429 and 5xx (at most 5 minutes; a longer `Retry-After` is returned as `RateLimitError`), maps `X-Error-Code` (huggingface.co answers 401 for Repos it hides), follows `Link` pages only on the Upstream's origin, sends no Xet headers, records one span per request with a URL template (never the URL), and redacts every `*url.Error` so presigned query strings never reach errors, logs or spans.

## Definition of done, with evidence

All runs on 2026-10-14 on macOS, Docker for Postgres.

| DoD item | Evidence |
|---|---|
| `compat/upstream` green | `go test -count=1 -tags compat ./compat/upstream/` on this branch: all six tests pass (huggingface.co Pull with SHAs and `git fsck`, Partial mirror of one quant, Pull-through, tracking, bandwidth cap, resume after a kill). In a throwaway merge with every batch A branch, `HANGAR_TEST_POSTGRES=1 go test -count=1 -tags 'compat w6real' -v ./compat/upstream/` passes all 13 test functions in 232 seconds (`TestRealWorkerProcess` among them is the worker process the kill test starts; below). |
| Pull resume after kill | Fakes: `TestPullResumesFromUploadedParts` (connection drops after 3.5 parts; the retry asks `Range: bytes=3072-`), `TestResumeAfterKillingTheWorkerMidFile` (worker cancelled mid-part, a new Service resumes after the two finished parts). Real: `TestRealResumeAfterKillingTheWorkerProcess` starts a worker **process** on Postgres, sends it SIGKILL during the transfer, and W1's lease expiry hands the Job to a second worker, which resumes: `killed after 3145728 bytes; resumed with bytes=3145728-`, content verified. |
| Dependency resolution on fixtures including the Jina form | `deps.TestParseJinaAutoMap` (jina-embeddings-v3's real `auto_map` plus list values with `null`, `@revision`, same-Repo values), `TestParseOtherSources`, `FuzzParse`; `TestDependenciesPullRecursivelyWithCycles` pulls the Jina pair, stops the cycle back, and shows needs and needed-by; `TestDependencyDepthLimitAndAutoPullOff`, `TestResolveDependenciesOfUploadedRepos`. |
| Discover arsenal-state merging | `TestDiscoverMarksArsenalState` (full, partial, none, update available, cache hit, cache per token, cache expiry, private Mirror shown as none to others), `TestDiscoverDetail`, `TestUpstreamsAPI`. |
| Pull windows and bandwidth cap | Fakes: `TestPullWindowsAndPullNow`, `TestRunningTransferWaitsAtPartBoundaryWhenWindowCloses` (resumes with `bytes=1024-` the next night). Real W1 worker: `TestRealPullWindowsAndPullNow` (snoozed with the window message and `run_after` at the window, attempts 0; Pull now transfers). Cap, real `jobs.DBLimiter` with two workers on one database, 60 seconds: `two workers moved 15728640 bytes in 60.0 s under a 262144 B/s cap: 100.0 % of the cap` (a second run under load: 96.2 %); in-process shared bucket with two workers on the fakes, 60 seconds: `moved 15728640 bytes in 59.9 s across 2 workers ... (100.2 % of the cap)`. |
| Imports from an HF cache and LM Studio folder | `TestImportWithFakeTarget` and `TestImportWithHTTPTarget` (huggingface_hub's cache layout with symlinks, offline cache, LM Studio match and fallback, directory, Ollama manifests; no upstream download). Real: `TestRealImportThroughTheNativeAPI` runs `importer.HTTPTarget` against W2's upload and Repo endpoints, W6's Pull endpoints and W4's Hub API. |
| `make lint test` | Green in this worktree: `golangci-lint` 0 issues, Biome, `tsc`, the em dash check, every Go package with `-race` on SQLite and Postgres, Vitest (`EXIT 0`). |

The real-backend runs used a throwaway worktree that merged `ws/w6-upstreams` with `ws/w1-platform`, `ws/w2-repo-core`, `ws/w5-identity`, `ws/w3-git-server` and `ws/w4-hub-api` (no conflicts; one W1/W5 test helper clash in `internal/api` renamed there only, as `requests/w2.md` item 8 describes). There, `go test ./internal/upstream/... ./internal/api/` also passed. Those runs:

- `TestRealPullAndTrackFromASecondInstance` (SQLite and Postgres): a second Instance built from W2, W3 and W4 is the Upstream; the Pull runs on W1's worker into W2's Repo service with W5's Organisations; same SHAs; the Mirror refuses pushes; a new Commit and then a force-push are followed, the replaced tip is kept, `git fsck` passes.
- `TestRealPullThroughWithHFHubDownloadAndGitLFS`: `huggingface_hub.hf_hub_download` against W4's Hub API with Pull-through gets the upstream bytes for a Repo the Instance did not have, and `git clone` with git-lfs through W3's server fetches a not-present object through the signed Pull-through link.
- `TestRealBandwidthCapAcrossTwoWorkers`, `TestRealPullWindowsAndPullNow`, `TestRealResumeAfterKillingTheWorkerProcess`, `TestRealImportThroughTheNativeAPI`: above.
- It also checks at compile time that `upstream.PullThrough` implements `gitserver.PullThrough`, `upstream.Registry` implements `auth.UpstreamLookup`, `auth.UpstreamTokenStore` implements `upstream.UserTokens`, `repo.Store` implements `upstream.MirrorStateSetter` and `jobs.Windows` implements `upstream.Windows`.

## Known gaps

- **Annotated tags that move upstream** are not followed: `repo.Refs` returns peeled targets, so the compare-and-swap value of an annotated tag's ref is unknown; the sync logs and skips it. New annotated tags and moved lightweight tags work.
- **Pull-through across replicas:** a request on a replica that is not transferring the object waits for it to be stored and then streams it, so a client with a short read timeout (`hf_hub_download` waits 10 seconds for bytes) may retry. A local transfer that a `pull.file` Job on another replica also starts (after the one-minute delay) downloads the object twice; rare, and deduplicated in storage.
- **Pull-through streams bytes before the SHA-256 check finishes,** as the spec asks; the object becomes visible in the Arsenal only once verified.
- **`hangar import` of tiny LFS objects:** W2's upload plan answers `inline` for files under `hfapi.regular_upload_max` that `.gitattributes` does not track; such a file in a Mirror cannot be stored by the import and is reported. Real model weights are far larger, and GGUF Repos track `*.gguf`.
- **Mirror progress in `GET /jobs/{id}`** is the parent Pull's view, refreshed every `PollInterval` (3 seconds); per-transfer progress is in the `pull.file` Jobs.
- **Dataset Viewer answers in Discover** are fetched live (no cache), at most three requests per detail view.
- **`Selection` union with excludes** keeps only excludes both sides share, so a Mirror can take more files than one Pull excluded, never fewer.
- **CI:** the huggingface.co tests ran on a developer machine only. AWS-hosted Upstreams and corporate mirrors were not tested; protocol v0 is tested with `git http-backend` with v2 turned off.

## What the integration lead must wire

Everything is in [`requests/w6.md`](../requests/w6.md) items 1 to 4: build `upstream.Registry` (call `SyncConfig` at start-up) and `upstream.Service`, register `pull`, `pull.file` and `mirror.sync`, embed `api.Upstreams` in the native server, mount `PullThrough().Handler()` at `/api/hangar/v1/pull-through/` outside auth, pass the Registry to W5, `PullThrough()` to W3 and (through the `ErrPullPending` adapter) to W4, `UpstreamMirrorSummary` to W2's Repo responses, the settings and bandwidth adapters, and a call to `ResolveDependencies` after each index. `compat/upstream/real_test.go` is that wiring in test form; once batch B is merged, drop its `w6real` build tag so the file runs with `compat`.
